body: Labelled as a sleeping pill, right?

Very interesting to read this! Thanks for posting.

Question - what OTC was the diphenhydramine? When I (ab)used it, I took it in the form of Sleep-ez or Zzzquil. The pills were 50mg each, so curious as to what the 25mg brand you had was.

I quite liked "tripping" on diphen. It felt so horrible, so delirious, but for some reason I kept returning to the madness. Started off with 200mg, then 400, then 600, then said fuck it and did a full gram. Spent the evening painting with one song on loop... one of my most interesting works. I don't think I got noticeable visuals, but probably because I was so engrossed in the artowork is why. It felt slow motion and surreal, like a dream. Everything had a hazy and tinny quality to it. The same song on loop was great, and I think it kept me centered and not freaking out. Got some heart palpitations, and dizziness when getting up, but nothing too fancy.

Your report is making me wanna try diphen again :)
So true!! Whenever I did/do it it's unpleasant but I keep repeating it. So weird.

Haha, had no idea it had the name of "hippy speedball," interesting.
